QUOTE: The reason string is set to say that no `index_scope` was declared, where the declaration was looked for, and what was excluded. That reason is what the build logs and what `IndexScope` reports, so the scope is never silently guessed.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the fallback scope carries a reason string explaining which scope was used and why, so it is never silently guessed.
